captions.detailed: A compact macro camera lens featuring a dark, cylindrical body with a wide, ribbed rubberized focus ring wrapped around the middle. At the front, an inner extension barrel holds a blue-tinted glass lens element. The focus ring is designed to rotate continuously around the main body (revolute joint), while the inner extension barrel telescopes forward and backward along the central axis (prismatic joint).
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact macro lens with a dark cylindrical main body, a ribbed focus ring, and an inner extension barrel holding a blue glass lens. Configure a revolute joint for the rotating focus ring and a prismatic joint for the telescoping inner barrel.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a cylinder primitive. Create the focus ring by defining a cylinder with outer grooves (ribs) subtracted or patterned, and attach it to the body via a revolute joint. Build the inner extension barrel using a smaller cylinder with a hollowed center containing a thin glass-colored disk for the lens, and mount it to the main body using a prismatic joint along the Z-axis.
